name: Tayo
source:
A human who frequents the forest to hunt. Despite her age, Tayo is already one of the greatest archers on this earth. She lives in her mother's shadow and strives to meet her expectations.

[From [url=http://birdling.invertmouse.com/]official site[/url]]
